hook: Luxury fashion loves a bold statement. Let's rank the craziest moments from Balenciaga and Gucci.
outro: Balenciaga or Gucci? Drop your pick and subscribe!

items.line: Balenciaga ran an ad campaign so disturbing it got pulled within days and dragged the whole brand into a real scandal. Not edgy, just a mistake. D-Tier, an all-time PR disaster.

Then Balenciaga sold rubber boots caked in fake mud for over a thousand dollars, and somehow people bought them. Confusing, expensive, technically genius marketing. C-Tier, mud never looked so pointless.
Gucci's ad campaigns keep leaning into weird, hallucinatory visuals that somehow still sell handbags. Bizarre, artistic, unmistakably Gucci. A-Tier, fashion as pure spectacle.

But Gucci Guilty has run the same seductive, star-studded perfume ad formula for over a decade and it still works every single time. Consistent, glamorous, timeless. S-Tier, they never had to change a thing.
